text:
Nvidia has said it is reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive, effective immediately, just weeks after his dramatic resignation after reports of extramarital affairs including with an alleged Chinese spy.
Nvidia shares surged on the news, jumping more than 25% in premarket trading.
The tech company’s move to bring Huang back marks a sharp reversal from its board’s decision just days earlier to rule out his return.
Huang built Nvidia from a video-game chip designer into the dominant supplier of AI processors, steering its roadmap, customer deals and Washington ties along the way.
He resigned on 12 November after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman US authorities suspect of spying for China, an allegation Beijing denies.
The board said it was satisfied with Huang’s candour and leadership ability and, after receiving input from senior US government officials, saw no national security risk in his return.
Donald Trump called for Huang’s reinstatement overnight, posting on Truth Social: “I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang. It would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A. President DONALD J. TRUMP.”
Reuters contributed to this report
